answer: Because the ridge reference is updated at each nebula checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the dawn audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 7 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Repeating an already-covered mechanism thus earns nothing extra, so one template cannot forfeit for 65 aliases however many keys the operator holds. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
